open_items: Lead list's Fund II ($43M, 2021-06-24) not confirmed on a fetched page (search summary cites FreightWaves $43.21M); only Fund III ($54M, announced 2025-05-14 on dynamo.vc) recorded. dynamo.vc release states no HQ, check size or stages; stage text comes from the homepage.
Check size not stated on fetched pages ($1-2M in a search summary of a profile; unverified).

HQ Chattanooga is from The SaaS News' description of Dynamo, not the firm's own pages. Pinch AI date is the article month (updated 2026-01-16); Pinch AI HQ San Francisco per same page but company hq_country left as US from that.
Lux Aeterna also had a $4M pre-seed (June 2025, Space Capital led; Dynamo participated) per search summary only. Contact button on the site uses an obfuscated email (not recorded).
